title: Satie — Gymnopédie No. 2

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2012/12/23-38, Evin Robertson after the Dover edition). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: 3/4, A minor (expectedFifths 0), 65 bars, no repeats. The only non-Germanic idiom in the suite.

A very wide left hand alternating bass and mid-register chords under long right-hand notes, held across barlines. That texture is where staff is least likely to equal hand, so the Mutopia track order is doing real work here.
No printed metronome mark, so expectedTempo is a wide band and tempoInRange is a diagnostic only.
